name: eq.artifact_packaging.v1
doc: Comparison conditions for the artifact-packaging workflow family. Frozen before any cohort is measured; changing any field creates a new contract version and invalidates cohorts measured under the old one.
heldConstant: input file family and byte content
permittedDifferences: which implementation realizes the packaging capability
the order in which declared members are supplied
invalidatingDifferences: a relaxed verification requirement on either side
a baseline that received the assisted path's output
a mixed warm and cold cache condition

evidenceStandard.note: Required for any vendor-token claim. Where no provider is called this requirement is inapplicable and the claim is limited to time and correctness.

failureRecoveryPolicy: a failed attempt stays in the cohort with its full cost; retries are counted, never discarded
tokenAccountingBasis: provider-reported usage under a pinned accounting version
minimumPairsNote: 25 matched pairs is the initial broad-claim policy; a smaller cohort produces an evaluation, not a published claim.
